title.zh: Python 3.13 现已成为默认版本

message.en:
Infernux Hub can now manage multiple Python runtimes side by side. Infernux 0.4.0 targets Python 3.13, while Python 3.12 remains available only for projects and engine versions that target it.

A fresh Hub installation includes Python 3.13. After an in-app Hub upgrade, open Installs to add it before installing Infernux 0.4.0. Existing projects keep their bound Python version.
message.zh:
Infernux Hub 现在可以并列管理多个 Python 运行环境。Infernux 0.4.0 对应 Python 3.13，Python 3.12 只为明确绑定它的旧项目和旧引擎版本保留。

全新安装的 Hub 已包含 Python 3.13；如果通过 Hub 内更新升级，请先在“安装”页面添加 Python 3.13，再安装 Infernux 0.4.0。已有项目会保留其绑定的 Python 版本。
